meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 给已有的谈话/采访/播客视频添加动态图文卡片，如标题、底部字幕、数据标注、引用、侧边栏、画中画，卡片与语音同步，原视频完整播放。
howto.when: 当你提到“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”、“package / dress up my video”等关键词，或要求给视频添加图文包装时触发。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加上动态标题和底部字幕。
say.note: 触发图文卡片包装流程。

say.text: 把这个播客片段包装一下，添加数据标注和引用卡片。
say.note: 根据内容自动设计卡片。

say.text: 为我的谈话视频制作画中画和侧边栏。

howto.what_en: Adds timed, designed graphic overlay cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture) synced to the transcript on top of an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video; the original clip plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video", or similar requests to add graphic packaging to a video.

say_en.text: Add dynamic titles and lower-thirds to this interview video.
say_en.note: Triggers the graphic card packaging workflow.

say_en.text: Package this podcast clip with data callouts and quote cards.
say_en.note: Cards are designed automatically based on content.

say_en.text: Create picture-in-picture and side panels for my talking-head video.
